messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Automated alert — spike in 502/504 rates observed at eu-west1 edge-proxy cluster (ingress-gw-*/pod). 5m error rate ~18%, latency p95 increased to 1.8s. Paging @oncall.
jordan.h: seeing it in dashboards — can confirm higher 5xx across multiple edge pools, looks like fanout amplification to regional egress. Linking grafana: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/edge/ew1?panel=5
sana.r: oncall here. what's customer impact so far? any big customers showing errors in SLO dashboard?
leo.m: quick check, partial failover already kicking for some routes, but not all. Route table shows mixed states. Running probe to representative backends.
kai.t: running probe: ```
curl -v -H "Host: model.redwood.ai" https://ew1-edge-proxy1.internal/health
> HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
> connection reset by peer
``` 
maria.p: adding context: we just rolled a config 30m ago that adjusted per-route keepalive and idle timeouts. Could be related.
jordan.h: good catch. Ops runbook suggests reverting recent gateway config if errors correlate. ops-runbook-bot: /runbook eu-edge-502
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook: eu-west1 5xx fanout — Steps: 1) Identify impacted pools, 2) Disable traffic steer to degraded pools, 3) Toggle edge-proxy keepalive to default, 4) Coordinate cross-region failover, 5) Notify CS. Link: https://runbooks.internal/eu-5xx
sana.r: doing step 1. Listing pools: ```
kubectl -n edge get pods -l region=eu-west1 -o wide
# shows ingress-gw-a,b,c with high restarts on c
``` 
leo.m: ingress-gw-c has repeated worker OOMs and 502s to downstream egress. I see increased queue depth on upstream connection pool.
kai.t: recommend immediate traffic steering: move 20% of ew1 traffic to eu-central pools for graceful drain. I'll prepare the policy tweak.
jordan.h: @kai.t paste the command you plan to run — want to review before apply.
kai.t: policy patch: ```
# feature flag: route-steer
PATCH /api/v1/route-policy/ew1
{
  "steer": [
    {"to": "eu-central1", "percent": 20},
    {"to": "us-east1", "percent": 5}
  ],
  "graceful": true
}
``` 
maria.p: thumbs up. also plan to revert the keepalive change after we steer.
sana.r: applying steer now (dry-run then apply). Dry-run output: "plan ok, estimated p95 change +50ms". Applying.
incident-bot: Action logged: @sana.r applied route-steer patch to ew1 at 2165432164. Monitoring effects.
leo.m: seeing immediate drop in ew1 502 rate to ~11% after 20% steer, queue depths starting to shrink on ingress-gw-c.
jordan.h: start customer-impact comms. Maria, can you pull error counts by customer and draft a short note for CS to send to affected accounts? Mark SEV2 for now.
maria.p: pulling counts -> top impacted customers: acme-inc (3% requests failing), shopwave (7% for a narrow set of routes). Draft: "We observed elevated 5xx from eu-west1 between 21:10-21:40 UTC; we have steered traffic and are mitigating, investigating root cause." Will post to #customer-comm in 5.
sana.r: rolling revert of keepalive now: ```
kubectl -n edge set configmap edge-proxy-config keepalive=default
kubectl rollout restart deployment/ingress-gw-c
``` 
kai.t: restart complete on c, monitoring. ingress-gw-c worker memory stabilized, restarts stopped.
leo.m: combined effect — 502 rate down to 4% and latency p95 back to ~350ms. Still seeing a handful of errors on long-tail routes.
jordan.h: good. plan next: keep steer in place for 30m while we validate, collect logs for postmortem. Can someone capture kv-cache + connection logs from ingress-gw-c between 21:00-21:20?
maria.p: grabbing logs now. snippet: ```
[21:07:12] upstream connect failed: ECONNRESET to 10.12.4.8:443
[21:07:12] downstream write error: client closed
[21:08:05] kvcache miss spike: 4800 -> 62k
``` 
sana.r: that kvcache miss spike lines up with when we saw slope of 5xx. may be cache eviction storm from new config.
leo.m: filing incident ticket and assigning to eng-ml to look at eviction heuristics; adding labels: eu-west1, edge-proxy, cache-eviction, 5xx.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2165432111 (Status: Mitigating). PagerDuty: alerted eng-ml, eng-sre. Link: https://incidents.internal/INC-2165432111
jordan.h: ok to move to recovery phase if stabilized. @sana.r propose monitor window 30m then start postmortem draft.
sana.r: agreed. I'll update status and handoff to the oncall for next hour @leo.m. Leaving steer in place until then. :white_check_mark:
leo.m: acknowledged takeover. I'll keep eyes on dashboards and start assembling timeline for postmortem. Thanks team.
ops-runbook-bot: Reminder: add remediation commands and timestamps to runbook entry. Use tag #INC-2165432111.
maria.p: posted customer note to #customer-comm and flagged impacted customers for follow-up.
incident-bot: All mitigation actions complete. Current status: partial region degradation mitigated, residual error rate ~1.2%. Next step: write postmortem and assign owners. :memo:
